verdict.rationale: The Edison client documents batch task execution. `run_tasks_until_done()` will "Run multiple tasks and wait for them to complete," and the tasks docs say you can "submit many jobs, while querying results at a later time." Directory uploads as collections add bulk file handling. missing for 10: documented bulk management operations beyond submission (e.g. bulk cancel, delete or update), batch size and limit details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: run_tasks_until_done() Run multiple tasks and wait for them to complete.
Sometimes you may want to submit many jobs, while querying results at a later time. The platform API supports this
